input.task: Show me the genius who wrote the quote about thinking.

provenance: PR #42 R8 (MEDIUM). R4's widening added `(?:name|list|give|show)(?: me)? the \w+s`, and the comment beside it plus ADR-022's regex section both claimed the required trailing `s` is what separates 'the authors' from 'the author'. It does not: `\w+s` reads ANY singular noun ending in s as plural, so 'Show me the address of...', 'Name the business that...', 'Give me the status of...' and 'Show me the class of...' all began refusing a narrowing that used to work — a capability regression in the safe direction, undeclared, and pinned by nothing in either direction. Watched red first on this task, whose singular noun ends in `us`: `status failure:locate`, `3 matches at tier text`. The fix requires the character before the final `s` not to be `s`, `u` or `i`, which is what the four demonstrated nouns have in common (addre-ss, busine-ss, stat-us, cla-ss) and what no English plural has.

triage.what_this_grades: the OVER-firing direction of the plural test, which had no case at all — every other plural case grades under-firing. Red when the exclusion is removed, green with it, and the plural family stays green either way, so the two directions are pinned independently.
triage.ceiling: still a spelling rule, not a grammar: a singular noun ending in any other letter plus s (`the lens`, `the news`, `the gas`) is still read as plural and still refuses to narrow. Declared as a fourth shape in docs/support-matrix.md D28 — the cost is a loud failure, never a wrong answer, which is why it is declared rather than chased.
